label: Confesses as naming a being: N.ConfessesReferent m n: the move m confesses, with the name n, that…
term: confesses as naming a being (a move)
definition: `N.ConfessesReferent m n`: the move m confesses, with the name n, that there is a being n names, as the confession of 'unum verum Deum ... Creatorem et Dominum' does. A property of the move's content, not a fact about reference.
note: Stipulated for #1010; whether a correct such move makes the name refer is the open bridge STMT-GRAMMAR-FIXES-REFERENCE.
